title: DepositReserveTable
description: SERVER-ONLY. Shape of data/world/deposit-reserves/{star_system_id}.json (p1-03, ADR-0015 section 2): which mineral each deposit holds and its initial reserve. Split out of DEPOSIT_FIELD so that the client copy of data/ - which is exactly the files of data kinds whose registry consumers include client - never contains them. The mineral of a deposit reaches a client only through DEPOSIT_FIELD_STATE after the deposit is revealed (spec p1-02 I-68). Boot-time checks beyond this schema (boot failures): a DEPOSIT_FIELD file with the same star_system_id exists and the deposit_id sets are equal both ways; every mineral_id exists in data/minerals; every mineral has at least one deposit; regen_kg <= initial_reserve_kg; deposit_id unique. 단위 접미사 규약: **_kg 필드는 정수다** (primitives MassKg).

deposit_id.description: id of a row in the DEPOSIT_FIELD file of the same star system.
